title: Oracle Inputs
description: Scripted message sequence for the Comic Chat oracle harness (plan doc Tier 4)

description.description: Human-readable note on what this case is for and why it exists. Optional; cases 001-010 predate it.

seed.description: Initial PRNG seed (pins the CRT rand() stream)

tickSeedBase.description: Base for the deterministic GetTickCount replacement (base, base+1, ...)

treeDir.description: Path to the v2.5-beta-1-modern tree root (for avatar/art loading). If empty, uses exe-relative path.

messages.description: Scripted messages to replay through the engine

text.description: Message text (may include <Brk>, formatting codes, unicode)

mode.description: BM_ balloon-mode bit flags, passed straight through to CUnitPanelPage::MakeBalloon (panel.cpp:1075) - CChatDoc::ProcessLine does NOT run SM2BM, so these are BM_ values from defines.h:63, not the sequential SM_ values (SM_SAY=1..SM_ACTION=5). 1=BM_SAY (CBWoodringNormal), 2=BM_WHISPER, 4=BM_THINK, 8=BM_ACTION (CBWoodringBox - and the only value that trips the `uModes == BM_ACTION` new-panel driver in AddLine), 10=BM_ACTION|BM_WHISPER (dashed box, does NOT break the panel since that test is an exact equality). 0 is not a mode: it falls through MakeBalloon's `default:` "should never happen" branch, which ASSERTs in a debug build.

bbCooked.description: Whether the message is pre-cooked (1 = skip ChatPreSendText)

panelWidth.description: Panel width in world units (SetUnitPanelWidth). Default 4860, floor MINUNITPANELWIDTH=2300 - the same clamp CPageView::SetPanelsWide applies. Narrowing width while leaving panelHeight tall is how the avatar-overflow shrink branch is reached.

panelHeight.description: Panel height in world units. Default 4860. Separate from panelWidth because bodies scale to m_unitHeight/1.9, so narrowing both together cannot produce an avatar overflow.
